verses.gurmukhi: ਬੀਸ ਕੇ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਭਏ ਨ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਹੇਮ ਨ ਭਏ ਮਨੂਰ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: bees ke baratamaan bhe na subaas baa(n)s hem na bhe manoor log bedh giaan hai ||

en.bdb: Practically, bamboo cannot acquire fragnance and iron cannot become gold. However, through the Guru, a bamboo-like arrogant person can acquire the fragnance of virtues and a vice ridden person (dirty like iron) can become pious and shine like gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਕੋ ਬਰਤਮਾਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਾਸੈ ਦੁ੍ਰਮ ਆਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th ik iees ko baratamaan cha(n)dhan subaas baa(n)s baasai dhuram aan hai ||

en.bdb: The path of Sikhism is a path of One God. The sandalwood like True Guru blesses a bamboo-like arrogant person with humility and Naam making him full of virtuous qualities. His dedication to Naam Simran instills fragrance into other similar persons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਮਨੂਰ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਭੇਟਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਨੂਰ ਕਰੈ ਅਉਰ ਠਉਰ ਮਾਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ka(n)chan manoor hoi paaras paras bheT paaras manoor karai aaur Thaur maan hai ||

en.bdb: Vice laden iron waste-like person becomes philosopher-stone by touching Paaras (philosopher stone) like True Guru. The True Guru converts the wasted person into gold like virtuous. He earns respect everywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਰੀਤਿ  ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਾਨਿ ਹੈ ॥੮੪॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh saadh sa(n)g patit puneet reet  gursikh sa(n)dh mile gursikh jaan hai ||84||

en.bdb: The congregation of holy and true disciples of a True Guru is capable of making the sinners into pious persons. One who joins the congregation of true Sikhs of Satguru is also known as Guru's disciple. (84)
